addressed: ForecastCapacityEngine now allocates overlapping intervals cumulatively and searches alternative routes.
PlanningForecastIntegrationTest covers competing plans, persisted planned placement, alternative light zones, dark/light phases, non-overlapping proposals and no mutation during projection.
saveBatch retains selected placement, and soaking retains that intent without counting as current occupancy.
Plan, Today and suggestion editor share planningForecast.
remainingEvidence: shared/data/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/sedsoftware/sproutpace/data/WorkspaceProjections.kt: GrowZone.futureConflict still accumulates every future planned start into projected occupancy without an interval end.
The new ForecastCapacityEngine permits separated forecast intervals to reuse capacity, while the Zones calculation can report a conflict for the same separated planned batches.

Committed allocations are consumed internally by planningForecast, but the returned list contains only suggestions; production tests do not establish consistent conflict presentation for already saved overlapping plans across Plan and Zones.
findings.requiredChange: Use consistent forecast semantics for Zones and saved-plan projections, while preserving the rule that predicted harvest does not release actual occupied trays.
findings.verification: Through production projections, compare a one-place zone with two non-overlapping saved planned batches, then overlapping saved batches. Assert consistent dates/counts/conflicts across Zones, Plan and editor, including applicable dark/light phases.

findings.title: Remaining component and Store acceptance claims exceed their assertions
findings.addressed: New connected tests materially improve Repeat, sowing confirmation, stage skip and harvest completion. Those rows are credited separately.
evidence: ScreenComponentContractTest still uses ScenarioManager, assertCommandScenario and assertSnapshotScenario to return prepared results for many acceptance scenarios.
These tests establish forwarding, generic confirmation and projection contracts, but not all claimed production calculations, persistence effects, restart behavior or user-input paths.
The new connected lifecycle tests cover specific flows; they do not close unrelated CRUD, backup, privacy, offline and native component rows.
findings.requiredChange: For remaining F04 rows, add or identify meaningful connected production assertions. Fake external ports are acceptable; prepared business results cannot substitute for the behavior being claimed.
findings.verification: Use tests that fail when actual routing, production mutation or calculation is disconnected. Cover confirmation/cancellation/restart only where required by the scenario; do not require artificial per-control paperwork.

findings.title: Current native platform acceptance remains incomplete
evidence: Platform graph and adapter hashes are unchanged from the baseline.
The current Gradle receipt proves Android builds and host tests, not actual alarm delivery, native picker failure paths, process recovery or configured native Crashlytics behavior.
The existing Android runtime report still ends with the earlier Settings regression retest and preserves explicit accessibility/native limits.
The four exact request-declared iOS/macOS pairs remain unavailable.
findings.requiredChange: Complete a current native Android acceptance matrix and obtain macOS native build/runtime/CI evidence. Keep conditional external qualification inactive until its stated condition is enabled.
findings.verification: Bind native observations to the tested build/workspace and assert permission recovery, delivery/cancellation, restart/time-zone behavior, picker cancellation/failure and applicable recovery.

findings.title: Accessibility and keyboard behavior remain unverified
evidence: AccessibilityContractTest is unchanged and largely checks source text for roles, headings, target sizes and live-region declarations.
No current test or runtime evidence establishes complete screen-reader traversal/spoken order, dynamic announcements, focus restoration or all keyboard workflows.
The new visual report explicitly preserves these boundaries.
findings.requiredChange: Add meaningful semantics/focus/keyboard tests and complete bounded native screen-reader review of primary flows and risky dialogs/editors.
findings.verification: Demonstrate logical traversal, spoken labels/state, announcements, visible focus and complete keyboard operation at required scales; screenshots alone cannot close these rows.

findings.title: Catalog numerical source derivation remains unresolved
evidence: Exact densities and stage ranges still lack per-culture numerical derivation.
harvestDays remains stored as LIGHT_GROWTH duration and accumulated with blackout; the source interpretation remains unresolved.
findings.requiredChange: Document primary-source derivations, units, assumptions and total-cycle versus light-stage interpretation for all eight cultures, labeling app estimates honestly.
findings.verification: Substantiate the numerical values and localized guidance; identity/resource tests and visual review do not prove content accuracy.

findings.title: Continuous forecast supplies today's date as the actual-harvest input
evidence: PlannerEngine.nextContinuousSuggestion names and uses that argument as actualHarvestDate, taking the maximum of it and the persisted anchor.
Once today exceeds the anchor, unchanged stored data can produce a different target date and suggestion ID on each calendar day.
PlanningForecastIntegrationTest checks same-clock agreement among Today, Plan and editor plus pause, but not calendar rollover, actual harvested outcomes or whether the next batch is needed.
The existing domain test proves the engine with an explicitly supplied actual harvest date; it does not prove this production caller.
findings.requiredChange: Derive continuous scheduling from the approved persisted/current-batch semantics rather than silently substituting today's date for an actual harvest. Preserve deterministic restart behavior and intentional next-needed evaluation.
findings.verification: Use the real production manager with a persisted continuous plan and terminal/active batches across two clock dates. Assert intended target identity/date, actual-harvest influence, pause/resume and suppression of already covered suggestions.

closedFindings.reason: Repeat now routes to a retained prefilled editor without mutation. Connected file-backed tests assert unchanged storage before Save and after discard, new identity on Save, copied snapshots, unchanged original history and actual reopen equality.

Stage rows now navigate to lifecycle/outcome handling. The manager rejects status-only completion/skip for stage tasks. Connected tests assert confirmation, state/placement/event changes, rebuilt work, explicit skip reason, duplicate protection and harvest release.

A current local post-golden Lazyweb-reference report now maps all primary screen families, links concrete references, binds 32 primary captures to verified hashes, incorporates changed risk captures and records dispositions and runtime boundaries. This closes the bounded design-review evidence gap, not accessibility or functional acceptance.

Updated manifest references were independently hash-checked without mismatches. All 29 assets have output/usage/visual bindings; current validators pass. Native icon masks/backgrounds and all eight culture covers were visually inspected alongside prior unchanged production captures. No legal/trademark or native runtime claim is inferred.
